note: The contract 0x1315 buys USDC against POND on the POND/USDC pool (0xd187) in the front leg. The victim sells POND into that pool next. The contract then returns the USDC and takes back POND and WETH in the back leg, so the position is fully closed. The route runs through the POND/WETH pool 0xccb4, giving WETH of -3.232969 then +3.268195, which is +0.035226. Treating the sender EOA and the contract as one operator, the 0.114227 ETH sent to the EOA in the front leg is internal. The 0.013165 ETH sent to 0x99c8 in the back leg is a cost. That leaves +0.022061 ETH, against 0.024731 ETH of gas, so about -0.00267 ETH after gas. If the contract is counted alone, the result is more negative.
